author: raoatifshad
body:
Since 1cf7ce519 the step0 logs are read too, which is good, but the errors and warnings of workflow 17034.96 now show up one step too late on the IB dashboard (from CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-20-1100 on).

workflow.log has no status for step0, so the dashboard takes the first number in the list as step 1. With step0 in the list everything moves by one: the 10 errors of step 3 are shown at step 4, and the errors of step 4 are not shown at all.

There is also a possible crash. The list has room for the highest step number in the directory. If a workflow has step0 to step4 and nothing else there goes past step 4, the fifth log does not fit and parseLog stops with an IndexError. Then the counts of all workflows in that directory are missing.

So I just leave step0 out of the list. Its log is still read and sent to Elasticsearch, and step10 and above are not touched.
title: Keep step0 out of the RelVal error and warning counts
